game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Stump Court, a court around a giant stump: the wood elf archer must handle shadow wolves while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Reverse Countdown: Count backward with range(10, 0, -1) to time perfect launches.
theme: Mystic Forest – Stump Court: a court around a giant stump
core_gameplay_loop: In Stump Court, repeat each round: Count backward with range(10, 0, -1) to time perfect launches. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the launch_timing value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 11 consecutive correct decisions about launch_timing to power up the wood elf archer and open the herb garden.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 4 (applied tier): Reverse Countdown
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
